name: Isolated Pixel
algorithm: Isolated Pixel — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects isolated pixel anomalies for image forensic analysis:

1. **像素Neighborhood分析**: For each pixel, its value is compared against its local neighborhood (3×3, 5×5, or 7×7 windows). Isolated pixels — those whose values differ significantly from all neighbors — are identified as potential artifacts.

2. **统计Outlier检测**: Using robust statistics (median absolute deviation), pixels whose intensity, color, or gradient values are statistical outliers relative to their local neighborhood are flagged. Natural images rarely contain truly isolated pixels due to optical blur and sensor integration.

3. **AIGeneration伪影检测**: AI image generators (particularly diffusion models, per Corvi et al., 2023) can produce isolated pixel anomalies through: (a) quantization artifacts in the denoising process, (b) numerical precision issues during generation, (c) boundary artifacts between generated regions. These isolated pixels have a different statistical signature than camera noise.

4. **空间分布分析**: The spatial distribution of detected isolated pixels is analyzed. Random distribution suggests sensor noise (expected). Clustered or patterned distribution suggests generation artifacts or manipulation. The method distinguishes between natural sensor noise (Poisson + Gaussian) and synthetic pixel anomalies.

5. **IsolationMapGeneration**: A spatial map of pixel isolation scores is generated. High-isolation regions are marked as suspicious. The overall score reflects the density and pattern of isolated pixels compared to what's expected from the estimated imaging pipeline.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： isolated 像素 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Corvi et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
